newsitem.title: FRANCE: FIGURE SKATING-ELTSOVA AND BUSHKOV WIN PAIRS.
newsitem.headline: FIGURE SKATING-ELTSOVA AND BUSHKOV WIN PAIRS.

text.p: Marina Eltsova and Andrei Bushkov of Russia survived an early mistake to add the European pairs figure skating title to their world crown on Wednesday.
The Russian couple captured their second European title with a clear victory in a high quality free skating battle against Germans Mandy Woetzel and Ingo Steuer, the champions two years ago.
The Russians, who won on their first appearance in 1993, looked to have thrown away their chance when Eltsova lost balance and touched one hand on the ice on their first jump, a triple loop.
But she picked herself up and they skated flawlessly for the rest of their routine.
The Germans, who had beaten the Russian pair three times this season, were also excellent but could not overtake their rivals, losing on an 8-1 decision from the nine judges.
Russians Elena Berezhnaia and Anton Sikharulidze moved up one place to third, knocking Sarah Abitbol and Stephane Bernadis of France down to fourth.
